summary_sentence_1: Surviving for 33 Days is a post-apocalyptic idle card RPG in which players assemble heroes, arrange a squad, and hold back zombie hordes.
summary_sentence_2: Its differentiator is a lightweight survival loop that combines idle progression with strategic line-up building and high-volume combat.
enrichment_notes: Official 37 page confirms the title, studio, publisher family, mobile positioning, and gameplay loop.

summary_sentence_1: Fierce Ghosts: Three Kingdoms turns the Three Kingdoms setting into a supernatural card RPG where players command ghost versions of historic generals.
summary_sentence_2: The core appeal is squad collection and tactical team-building across a three-sided conflict between humans, spirits, and ghosts.
enrichment_notes: Google Play confirms developer, store availability, and the game description. No primary iOS listing was confirmed.

summary_sentence_1: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: GS is an officially licensed mobile RPG based on the JoJo anime, with characters drawn from across the franchise.
summary_sentence_2: It combines team formation and strategic battles with 3D and Live2D presentation designed to recreate iconic anime scenes.
enrichment_notes: Google Play confirms Hoolai Game Limited; launch coverage confirms 13 August mobile launch and iOS/Android availability.

summary_sentence_1: Undead Tribe: Battle is a short-session tower-defense RPG where players summon and merge heroes to protect a tribe from waves of undead.
summary_sentence_2: Its USP is a quick three-minute match loop that mixes random hero merges, faction combinations, and defensive strategy.
enrichment_notes: App Store confirms title, developer, iPhone/iPad availability, and described gameplay.

summary_sentence_1: EZ PZ: Byte Heroes is a pixel-art Three Kingdoms strategy card RPG built around a six-grid formation system and faction-based hero combinations.
summary_sentence_2: It blends tactical team positioning with idle progression and high-frequency loot drops, including shared equipment that can strengthen an entire squad.
enrichment_notes: Google Play confirms developer, Android availability, and game systems.

summary_sentence_1: MAJO - Apocalypse Tactics RPG is a dark tactical RPG in which the player commands witches to investigate and defeat reality-distorting anomalies.
summary_sentence_2: Its combat differentiates itself through timed dodges, blocks, knockdowns, burst attacks, and four squad roles that create team synergies.
enrichment_notes: Official site and Google Play confirm the publisher/developer, mobile availability, premise, and tactical systems.

summary_sentence_1: Fields of Mistria is a pixel-art farming and life-simulation RPG where players rebuild a village, farm, fish, mine, craft, and explore magical ruins.
summary_sentence_2: Its USP is the blend of cosy town life, romance, seasonal activities, and light adventure in a nostalgic farm-sim format.
enrichment_notes: Steam confirms developer, publisher, genre, PC platform, release date, and game description.

summary_sentence_1: Survival Log is a zombie-apocalypse survival simulation where players scavenge before an outbreak, then manage and fortify a home base.
summary_sentence_2: It combines timed preparation, resource management, base-building, exploration, and repeat-run progression where failed attempts create experience for the next run.
enrichment_notes: Steam confirms Midnight Workshop, Lilith Games, PC release date, and survival-management loop.

summary_sentence_1: Sandustry is a factory automation game set on fully destructible worlds where every pixel can be mined, processed, or used in production chains.
summary_sentence_2: Its USP is a physics-led resource system: materials such as sand, water, ice, and steam react to one another as players build an expanding industrial operation.
enrichment_notes: Steam confirms developer, publisher, Early Access release date, PC platform, and systems.

report_name: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
summary_sentence_1: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising is a Lovecraftian idle RPG where players build a cult town, equip a party, and send Godsworn characters into automated battles.
summary_sentence_2: It is designed around low-input progression, loot and gear crafting, six classes, town building, and strategy around party composition.
enrichment_notes: Steam confirms Small Mill as developer/publisher, PC release date, genre, and gameplay systems.
